themes.name: CNN Benchmarking on Fashion-MNIST
themes.description: A large body of work uses Fashion-MNIST as a standard testbed for comparing CNN architectures, ranging from classic LeNet-5 to modern residual and attention-based models. These papers establish baseline accuracy ranges and typical architectural choices for the dataset.

themes.name: Effect of Data Augmentation on CNN Generalisation
themes.description: These papers directly investigate whether and how much data augmentation improves CNN classification accuracy, typically comparing augmented versus non-augmented training conditions. They consistently find that basic geometric augmentations reduce overfitting and raise test accuracy, though effect sizes vary by dataset, model, and training length.

themes.name: Augmentation Techniques and Their Specific Impact
themes.description: Studies in this theme focus on specific augmentation operations — flipping, cropping, rotation, circular shift, context placement — and measure their individual or combined contributions. Results suggest horizontal flips and small translations are among the most consistently beneficial basic techniques.

themes.name: Training Dynamics: Hyperparameters, Optimizers, and Batch Size
themes.description: This group examines how training configuration choices such as batch size, optimizer type, and activation function affect CNN performance, providing context for interpreting accuracy differences across training conditions.

themes.name: Lightweight and Efficient CNN Design
themes.description: Several papers focus on building small, parameter-efficient CNNs that remain competitive in accuracy, which is directly relevant to the study's use of a small CNN architecture on a constrained training budget.

themes.name: Data Augmentation in Specialised or Non-Standard Domains
themes.description: These papers apply augmentation to medical images, biological cells, plant leaves, agricultural produce, and handwriting recognition, confirming the generality of augmentation benefits but also highlighting that effect sizes can vary when training data is very scarce or domain-specific.

themes.name: Federated and Privacy-Preserving Learning with Fashion-MNIST
themes.description: A smaller set of papers uses Fashion-MNIST as a benchmark in federated or privacy-preserving learning contexts, relevant primarily as evidence of the dataset's broad adoption as a standard testbed rather than directly addressing augmentation.

overview.summary:
Research on convolutional neural networks for image classification has matured considerably, with Fashion-MNIST emerging as a standard small-image benchmark. Studies consistently show that simple architectural choices (small filters, batch normalization, dropout) combined with basic data augmentation (flips, crops, rotations) can push test accuracy well above 90%, with state-of-the-art results now approaching 99.65% on this dataset. The question of whether augmentation meaningfully helps generalisation is largely answered affirmatively across many domains and datasets, though the magnitude of the benefit depends heavily on training set size, model capacity, and the specific augmentation strategy applied.

For a small CNN trained for only ~5 epochs on Fashion-MNIST's 60,000 images, the benefit of simple augmentation is likely modest but measurable. Most empirical studies find that basic geometric augmentations reduce overfitting and improve test accuracy, especially when training runs are short and model capacity is limited. However, very few studies isolate exactly the experimental design described here (identical architecture, fixed seeds, short training), meaning the field provides directional guidance rather than a precise quantitative prediction for this specific setup.
open_problems: How large is the accuracy gain from simple augmentation specifically for small CNNs trained for only ~5 epochs on Fashion-MNIST, where underfitting rather than overfitting may dominate?
Two seeds (42 and 123) are insufficient for statistical significance testing — it is unclear how much run-to-run variance should be expected and how to interpret small accuracy differences.
Combining multiple augmentation techniques does not always improve over single techniques, and the reasons for this interaction are poorly understood.
Most studies report only final test accuracy rather than training curves, making it hard to understand whether augmentation accelerates or slows early-epoch learning.
Optimal augmentation hyperparameters (flip probability, crop fraction, rotation angle) are rarely tuned systematically; the default values used may not be optimal for a given architecture or dataset.

The relationship between dataset size and augmentation benefit is insufficiently characterised — it is unclear whether Fashion-MNIST's 60,000 training images is large enough that simple augmentation yields only marginal gains.
Generalisation of augmentation findings across datasets remains limited, with most individual studies confined to a single benchmark, making cross-dataset conclusions difficult.

papers.title: A Unified Lightweight Benchmark for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning in Cyber-Physical Systems (Fashion-MNIST Case Study)
papers.venue: Consumer Communications and Networking Conference

notes.problem: How do differential privacy and secure aggregation compare in terms of utility, communication, computation, and formal privacy guarantees in federated learning for cyber-physical systems?
limitations: Study focuses only on Fashion-MNIST; generalizability to other datasets is untested.
HE is supported by the framework but not empirically evaluated in this study.
notes.contribution: A lightweight open benchmark for apples-to-apples comparison of differential privacy and secure aggregation in federated learning under resource-constrained, non-IID conditions.
key_findings: Non-private FedAvg reaches 86.50% accuracy in 6 rounds with 202 MB communication.
DP (ε=1.86, δ=1e-5) drops accuracy to 76.30%, requires 120 rounds, and uses 4.05 GB communication.
Secure aggregation preserves 82.50% accuracy in 7 rounds with only 124 MB traffic, adding modest cryptographic overhead.

papers.title: Lightweight CNN and Transfer Learning Techniques for Robust Small-Image Classification
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)

notes.problem: How do compact CNNs trained from scratch compare to pre-trained backbones in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and robustness for small-image classification?
limitations: Study limited to a single benchmark dataset (Fashion-MNIST)
Up-sampling 28x28 images to 224x224 may introduce artifacts affecting results
notes.contribution: Comprehensive comparison of lightweight CNNs and transfer learning models for small-image classification on Fashion-MNIST, analyzing accuracy, efficiency, and corruption robustness.
key_findings: Pre-trained backbones provide considerable performance improvement over compact CNNs
ResNet-18 offers the best overall balance between accuracy and efficiency
EfficientNet-B0 achieves highest clean accuracy but is fragile under Gaussian noise; ViT-Tiny is sensitive to rotations

papers.title: State-of-the-Art Results with the Fashion-MNIST Dataset
papers.venue: Mathematics

notes.problem: How well can classical ML models and simple CNNs classify Fashion-MNIST images, and how does the number of trainable parameters affect classification quality?
limitations: Experiments limited to Fashion-MNIST; generalizability to other datasets not demonstrated
notes.contribution: A CNN with three convolutional layers (CNN-3-128) achieves 99.65% accuracy on Fashion-MNIST, setting a new state-of-the-art result.
key_findings: CNN-3-128 achieved 99.65% accuracy on the Fashion-MNIST test set
There is a dependence between the number of adjustable parameters in a CNN and the maximum achievable classification quality

papers.title: Fashion-MNIST Classification Based on CNN Image Recognition
papers.venue: Highlights in Science Engineering and Technology

notes.problem: Which classic CNN architecture achieves the highest classification accuracy on Fashion-MNIST with limited training samples?
limitations: Small dataset of 70,000 images limits generalizability
Only three CNN architectures compared
notes.contribution: Empirical comparison of DenseNet121, MobileNet, and ResNet50 on Fashion-MNIST image classification, finding DenseNet121 most accurate.
key_findings: DenseNet121 outperforms MobileNet and ResNet50 on Fashion-MNIST under controlled training conditions

papers.title: Revolutionizing Image Recognition: Next-Generation CNN Architectures for Handwritten Digits and Objects
papers.venue: IEEE Symposium on Wireless Technology and Applications

notes.problem: How to improve handwritten digit and fashion object recognition accuracy beyond traditional machine learning methods like SVM and Random Forests.
notes.contribution: Two custom CNN architectures achieving 98.71% on MNIST and 91.39% on Fashion MNIST, outperforming traditional ML methods for image recognition.
key_findings: Custom CNN achieved 98.71% accuracy on MNIST without bias
Custom CNN achieved 91.39% accuracy on Fashion MNIST without bias
CNNs require less preprocessing than SVM or Random Forest methods

papers.title: Evaluation of CNN Models with Fashion MNIST Data

notes.problem: Which CNN architecture performs best on the Fashion MNIST dataset?
limitations: No numerical results reported in abstract
Single dataset evaluation limits generalizability
notes.contribution: Empirical comparison of four CNN architectures on the Fashion MNIST classification task
key_findings: ResNet achieved the best classification accuracy among the four evaluated CNN models on Fashion MNIST

papers.title: Measuring the Effect of Data Augmentation in a CNN-Based Deep Neural Network Model
papers.venue: International Conference on Scientific and Innovative Studies

notes.problem: How does data augmentation affect the performance of a CNN-based deep learning model for image classification?
limitations: Only one dataset (CIFAR-10) used for evaluation
Combining augmentation techniques did not improve performance, but reasons are not analyzed
notes.contribution: A CNN model evaluated with and without data augmentation on CIFAR-10, demonstrating the impact of augmentation techniques on classification performance.
key_findings: Data augmentation produced a large performance difference compared to no augmentation
Using different augmentation techniques together or individually did not further improve model performance
Proposed model achieved train accuracy 91.93%, precision 93.63%, recall 90.49%

papers.title: Optimized Neural Networks for Fashion-MNIST: A High-Accuracy Approach Using Augmentation and Tuning
papers.venue: International Mobile, Intelligent, and Ubiquitous Computing Conference (MIUCC)

notes.problem: How can CNN-based architectures be optimized to maximize classification accuracy on the Fashion-MNIST benchmark?
notes.contribution: A ResCNN architecture with residual blocks, modified design, and hyperparameter tuning achieves 98.30% test accuracy on Fashion-MNIST, surpassing prior CNN-based results by 4%.
key_findings: ResCNN achieved 98.30% test accuracy on Fashion-MNIST
This surpasses previous CNN-based literature on Fashion-MNIST by 4%
Residual blocks, modified architecture, and hyperparameter tuning contributed to performance gains

papers.title: OPTIMIZATION OF CONVOLUTIONAL RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORK (CRNN) MODEL WITH DATA AUGMENTATION FOR CIFAR-10 IMAGE CLASSIFICATION
papers.venue: JIPI (Jurnal Ilmiah Penelitian dan Pembelajaran Informatika)

notes.problem: Overfitting and suboptimal generalization when training image classification models on the small CIFAR-10 dataset.
limitations: Limited to CIFAR-10 small 32×32 images; advanced augmentation, deeper architectures, GANs, and transfer learning not yet explored.
notes.contribution: Optimizes a CRNN model with data augmentation to improve image classification accuracy on CIFAR-10 while reducing overfitting.
key_findings: Data augmentation yielded a 3.5% increase in accuracy compared to training without augmentation.
Augmentation also improved precision, recall, and F1-score, indicating more balanced classification performance.

papers.title: Classification of Fashion-MNIST Dataset by Using Lenet-5
papers.venue: Science and Technology of Engineering Chemistry and Environmental Protection

notes.problem: How effective is the classic LeNet-5 architecture on the Fashion-MNIST dataset for clothing image classification?
limitations: Only one model (LeNet-5) evaluated without comparison to more modern architectures
notes.contribution: Applies LeNet-5 CNN to Fashion-MNIST image classification and evaluates its effectiveness as a benchmark task.
key_findings: LeNet-5 achieves 95% training accuracy on Fashion-MNIST
LeNet-5 achieves 90% validation accuracy, indicating good generalization

papers.title: Research on data augmentation for image classification based on convolution neural networks
papers.venue: Chinese Automation Congress

notes.problem: How do various data augmentation methods affect CNN image classification performance when training data is limited?
limitations: Only 10 categories of ImageNet used
Limited to AlexNet architecture
notes.contribution: Empirical comparison of data augmentation methods for image classification with CNNs
key_findings: Performance gains from augmentation are more pronounced on small-scale datasets
Cropping, Flipping, WGAN, and Rotation individually perform better than other single methods
Appropriate combinations of augmentation methods are slightly more effective than individual methods

papers.title: Building Efficient Lightweight CNN Models
papers.venue: arXiv (Cornell University)

notes.problem: How to build CNNs that maintain competitive accuracy while meeting the computational and memory constraints of resource-limited environments.
limitations: Lower performance on complex datasets like CIFAR-10
Methodology evaluated only on classification tasks
Architectural scalability for more complex datasets needs further improvement
notes.contribution: A two-stage training methodology combining dual-input-output models and transfer learning with progressive unfreezing to build lightweight CNNs with competitive accuracy.
key_findings: Achieved 99% accuracy on MNIST and 89% on Fashion-MNIST with only 14,862 parameters and 0.17 MB model size.
CIFAR-10 accuracy was 65% with fewer than 20,000 parameters, showing scalability limits on complex datasets.
Progressive unfreezing enabled faster convergence and improved accuracy during fine-tuning.

papers.title: Effect of data-augmentation on fine-tuned CNN model performance
papers.venue: IAES International Journal of Artificial Intelligence (IJ-AI)

notes.problem: How does data augmentation affect the performance of fine-tuned CNN models when training data is limited?
limitations: Custom dataset limited to binary classification (cats vs dogs)
Results may not generalize to other domains or larger datasets
notes.contribution: Empirical analysis showing data augmentation improves fine-tuned CNN (VGG16, ResNet50) classification performance on a cats vs. dogs dataset
key_findings: ResNet50 with data augmentation achieved 90% test accuracy vs 82% without data augmentation
Both VGG16 and ResNet50 achieved better test accuracy when data augmentation was employed
ResNet50 outperformed VGG16 in all experimental conditions

papers.title: HEp-2 Cell Image Classification With Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

notes.problem: How to accurately classify HEp-2 cell images to facilitate autoimmune disease diagnosis
notes.contribution: A deep CNN framework for automatic HEp-2 cell image classification with analysis of data augmentation, masks, and cross-dataset adaptability
key_findings: Proposed CNN framework outperforms existing models with proper data augmentation
CNN framework shows excellent adaptability across different datasets
System ranked highly in ICPR 2014 cell image classification competition

papers.title: Circular Shift: An Effective Data Augmentation Method For Convolutional Neural Network On Image Classification
papers.venue: International Conference on Information Photonics

notes.problem: Common augmentation methods like rotation, crop, and flip can degrade performance for small images or objects with dispersed features.
limitations: Evaluated only on small image datasets
No theoretical analysis of why circular shift outperforms other augmentations
notes.contribution: A circular shift data augmentation method for CNNs that shifts images cyclically to provide variation without losing information.
key_findings: Circular shift augmentation consistently improves classification performance across different CNN-based models
Circular shift can be combined with existing augmentation methods for further performance gains
Circular shift avoids information loss that can occur with crop or rotation on small images

papers.title: A Convolutional Neural Network for Leaves Recognition Using Data Augmentation

notes.problem: How to effectively classify plant leaves using deep learning while mitigating overfitting on small datasets.
limitations: Evaluated on only one dataset (Flavia).
notes.contribution: A 7-layer CNN with data augmentation (rotation, translation, sharpening) for plant leaf recognition that outperforms prior methods on the Flavia dataset.
key_findings: The proposed 7-layer CNN with data augmentation outperforms other supervised learning methods on the Flavia leaf dataset.
Data augmentation via rotation, translation, and random sharpening reduces overfitting and improves generalization.

papers.title: Image-based classification of Golden Melon ripeness using convolutional neural networks and data augmentation
papers.venue: Springer Link (Chiba Institute of Technology)

notes.problem: How to accurately classify melon fruit maturity stages from images using machine learning and deep learning approaches.
limitations: Small dataset of only 230 images across four classes.
Study limited to a single melon variety (Golden Alisha).
notes.contribution: Demonstrates that a data-augmented CNN achieves 86% accuracy for classifying Golden Alisha melon maturity into four stages using a self-developed image dataset.
key_findings: Augmented CNN achieved the highest accuracy of 86%, outperforming PCA-SVM, PCA-NN, and baseline CNN.
The 60 DAP maturity stage was the most difficult to classify due to visual similarity with adjacent ripening stages.
Data augmentation (rotations, shifts, zooming, flipping) improved CNN robustness for agricultural maturity classification.

papers.title: Analysis on the Selection of the Appropriate Batch Size in CNN Neural Network
papers.venue: 2022 International Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Engineering (MLKE)

notes.problem: How should batch size be selected to balance accuracy and efficiency when training CNNs?
limitations: Limited to CNN architectures and three datasets
Does not cover very large-scale or modern architectures
notes.contribution: Empirical study identifying an appropriate batch size range (16–64) for training CNN models
key_findings: Mini-batch sizes between 16 and 64 are most likely to yield the most accurate models
A batch size of 32 is recommended as a starting point, decreasing for accuracy or increasing for efficiency
Dataset size, network depth, and power-of-2 batch sizes all influence the optimal batch size choice

papers.title: Comparison of Combinations of Data Augmentation Methods and Transfer Learning Strategies in Image Classification Used in Convolution Deep Neural Networks
papers.venue: IEEE Conference of Russian Young Researchers in Electrical and Electronic Engineering

notes.problem: Whether combining individually best-performing data augmentation and transfer learning approaches yields the best overall results
limitations: Very small dataset of only 40 training images limits generalizability
Only accuracy used as evaluation metric
notes.contribution: Empirical comparison of all combinations of data augmentation methods and transfer learning strategies in CNN image classification
key_findings: The combination of the individually best data augmentation method and best transfer learning strategy does not necessarily achieve the best combined result
Performance of combined methods cannot be predicted from separate comparisons of individual components

papers.title: Improve Image Classification Using Data Augmentation and Neural Networks
papers.venue: SMU Scholar (Southern Methodist University)

notes.problem: How to mitigate overfitting and improve CNN image classification performance using data augmentation and architecture choices.
limitations: Study limited to CIFAR-10 dataset
No comparison with more modern architectures beyond VGG16
notes.contribution: Demonstrates that combining data augmentation and hyperparameter tuning with VGG16 reduces overfitting and improves image classification accuracy on CIFAR-10.
key_findings: VGG16 with data augmentation achieves 96% train accuracy and 92% test accuracy on CIFAR-10
Overall image classification error rate dropped to 8%
Single class misclassification rates below 7.5% in 8 out of 10 classes

papers.title: On the Synergy of Optimizers and Activation Functions: A CNN Benchmarking Study
papers.venue: Mathematics

notes.problem: How do different optimizer and activation function combinations interact to affect CNN training dynamics and generalization performance?
limitations: Limited to CNN architectures only
Only four activation functions and eight optimizers evaluated
notes.contribution: Systematic benchmarking of all combinations of 8 optimizers and 4 activation functions in CNNs across three image classification datasets to reveal optimizer–activation synergies.
key_findings: Joint selection of optimizer and activation function significantly impacts CNN training dynamics and generalization
Two-way ANOVA confirmed statistically significant differences across optimizer–activation combinations
Learning rate and regularization methods play critical roles in optimization stability

papers.title: A Novel Method for Fashion Clothing Image Classification Based on Deep Learning
papers.venue: Journal of Information and Communication Technologies

notes.problem: Standard CNN models have unsatisfactory classification accuracy and overfitting issues on small datasets for fashion image classification.
limitations: Evaluated on a small subset of Fashion-MNIST (6,000 training, 1,000 test images)
Comparison limited to basic CNN; no thorough benchmarking against VGG16 or ResNet
notes.contribution: A CNN-based image classification method with improved convolutional/pooling layers and adaptive learning rate for fashion clothing images achieving 93% accuracy.
key_findings: Proposed model achieved 93% classification accuracy on Fashion-MNIST
4.6% improvement over basic CNN model
Adaptive learning rate update algorithm improved convergence speed and reduced training time

papers.title: The Effect of Data Augmentation in Deep Learning with Drone Object Detection
papers.venue: IJCCS (Indonesian Journal of Computing and Cybernetics Systems)

notes.problem: Does data augmentation improve deep learning accuracy for drone object detection given limited training data?
limitations: Only three augmentation techniques (rotate, crop, cutout) were evaluated
Dataset not publicly identified or described in detail
notes.contribution: Empirical evaluation of the effect of rotate, crop, and cutout data augmentation on YOLOv5 drone object detection accuracy
key_findings: Data augmentation did not improve YOLOv5 accuracy for drone object detection; precision and mAP@0.5 decreased while recall and F1 score remained relatively constant
Excessive or improper augmentation (rotate, crop, cutout) caused loss of important information and introduced noise or distortion

papers.title: Enhancing Convolutional Neural Network using Hu’s Moments
papers.venue: International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications

notes.problem: CNNs lack invariance to image transformations such as rotation, scaling, and skewness.
limitations: Evaluated only on three benchmark datasets
No comparison with other invariance-enhancing methods such as data augmentation or spatial transformer networks
notes.contribution: A method to enhance CNN invariance to geometric transformations by extracting Hu's moments and concatenating them with the flattened CNN feature vector before the fully connected layer.
key_findings: Concatenating Hu's moments with the CNN flatten vector improves performance on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10
The proposed approach achieves acceptable accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score across all three benchmark datasets

papers.title: Data Augmentation to Improve the Performance of a Convolutional Neural Network on Image Classification
papers.venue: International Conference on Decision Aid Sciences and Application (DASA)

notes.problem: How to train accurate CNN classifiers when the training dataset is too small for effective learning.
limitations: Specific dataset and numeric results not detailed in abstract.
notes.contribution: Demonstrates the impact of data augmentation, feature extraction, and fine-tuning on CNN image classification trained on small datasets.
key_findings: Data augmentation, feature extraction, and fine-tuning are effective strategies for improving CNN performance on small datasets.

papers.title: Improving the Performance of Neural Networks with an Ensemble of Activation Functions

notes.problem: Selecting the appropriate activation function for a neural network is a trial-and-error process that significantly affects model performance.
limitations: Only evaluated on classification tasks
Limited to four datasets
notes.contribution: Proposes an activation function ensembling method using majority voting to improve neural network classification accuracy.
key_findings: The proposed activation function ensemble with majority voting outperforms CNN, SVM, and RNN on all four benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Quantifying the Dynamics of Data Augmentation Hyperparameters for Facial Expression Recognition
papers.venue: Journal of Student Research

notes.problem: Which data augmentation strategies improve facial expression recognition, and how does dataset size moderate their effectiveness?
limitations: Specific dataset not named; threshold value not quantified in abstract.
notes.contribution: Empirical analysis of how data augmentation hyperparameters and dataset size affect facial expression recognition model performance.
key_findings: Data augmentation does not always improve performance; it can degrade performance when the dataset is small.
Models with data augmentation outperform those without only when training dataset size exceeds a certain threshold.

papers.title: Impact of data augmentation techniques on a deep learning based medical imaging task
papers.venue: SPIE Medical Imaging: Imaging Informatics for Healthcare, Research, and Applications

notes.problem: How do different data augmentation methods and network architectures affect deep learning performance for anatomy region localization when training data is limited?
limitations: Prediction inaccuracies observed at boundary regions between anatomies
Limited availability of annotated medical imaging data constrains training
notes.contribution: Empirical comparison of data augmentation techniques and neural network architectures for DL-based anatomy region localization from CT images
key_findings: Prediction accuracy improved from 88% to 97% with optimal data augmentation and architecture selection
Zoom, translation, and flips incrementally improved classifier performance while samplewise mean shift degraded it
Global average pooling outperformed fully-connected layers when limited data augmentation was used

papers.title: Leveraging Deep Learning for Personalized Fashion Recommendations Using Fashion MNIST
papers.venue: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research in Science and Business

notes.problem: How to build accurate, personalized fashion recommendation systems automatically for e-commerce platforms.
limitations: Only one dataset (Fashion-MNIST) used, limiting generalizability to real-world fashion diversity
No user interaction or preference data incorporated for true personalization
notes.contribution: A CNN-based deep learning framework for personalized fashion item classification and recommendation using Fashion-MNIST, outperforming FNN and LSTM baselines.
key_findings: CNN achieved 93.99% accuracy with F1-score, precision, and recall all at 94% and loss of 0.2037
CNN outperformed both FNN and LSTM models on all evaluated metrics

papers.title: A Study on Improvement of Tomato Disease Classification Performance According to Various Image Augmentation
papers.venue: The Transactions of The Korean Institute of Electrical Engineers

notes.problem: How to accurately classify tomato crop diseases without expert judgment using automated image-based methods.
limitations: Abstract is incomplete, limiting full assessment of methods and results.
notes.contribution: Proposes a CNN-based tomato disease classification system with various image augmentation strategies to improve classification performance.
key_findings: Image augmentation improves CNN-based tomato disease classification performance compared to no augmentation.

papers.title: Deep Learning Based Enhanced Handwritten Devanagari Character Recognition using Image Augmentation
papers.venue: International Computer Science Conference

notes.problem: How to improve accuracy of handwritten Devanagari script character recognition using deep learning
notes.contribution: A CNN model with batch normalization, dropout, and data augmentation for improved handwritten Devanagari character recognition
key_findings: Data augmentation improves model generalization and reduces overfitting for Devanagari character recognition
The proposed CNN with batch normalization and dropout achieves high accuracy on handwritten Devanagari characters

papers.title: The Impact of Data Augmentation Techniques on the Recognition of Script Images in Deep Learning Models
papers.venue: Jurnal Online Informatika

notes.problem: How do data augmentation techniques affect deep learning model accuracy when training data is limited, specifically for Komering script recognition?
limitations: Small dataset of only 500 images across five classes
Study limited to a single script and three augmentation techniques
notes.contribution: Investigates the impact of random rotation, height shift, and width shift augmentation techniques on deep learning model performance for Komering script character recognition.
key_findings: Deep learning models can recognize augmented Komering script data with an average accuracy of 80.05%
Three augmentation techniques (random rotation, height shift, width shift) successfully expanded a 500-image dataset across five classes

papers.title: The Effect of Data Augmentation on the Accuracy of Fish Species Classification Using Deep Learning
papers.venue: International Conference on Informatics and Computing (ICIC)

notes.problem: How does data augmentation affect the accuracy of deep learning models for fish species classification?
limitations: Only four fish species tested
Relatively small dataset of 3010 images
Single CNN architecture explored
notes.contribution: Demonstrates that data augmentation improves CNN-based fish species classification accuracy from 94.56% to 95%
key_findings: Model with data augmentation achieved 95% accuracy (loss 0.0983) vs 94.56% (loss 0.1794) without augmentation
Data augmentation helps the model generalize better to variations in fish image data

papers.title: Transfer learning-based Fashion Image Classification using Hybrid 2D-CNN and ImageNet Neural Network
papers.venue: International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology

notes.problem: How to efficiently classify fashion images with limited computing resources using transfer learning.
limitations: Only evaluated on Fashion MNIST; no comparison with more recent state-of-the-art models.
notes.contribution: A hybrid 2D-CNN transfer learning model combining VGG-16 and AlexNet for fashion image classification with improved accuracy and reduced loss.
key_findings: The proposed hybrid 2D-CNN transfer learning approach achieves higher training and validation accuracy with reduced loss compared to conventional methods.

papers.title: LiteNet-CNN: A novel efficient lightweight image classification network
papers.venue: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Trends in Industry 4.0 Technologies (ICETI4T)

notes.problem: How to design efficient neural networks for resource-constrained environments like mobile devices with minimal parameters but strong classification performance
limitations: Evaluated only on Fashion MNIST dataset
Test accuracy of 88.66% may not be sufficient for all applications
notes.contribution: LiteNet-CNN, a lightweight CNN with only 41,610 parameters, achieving competitive image classification performance on resource-constrained devices
key_findings: LiteNet-CNN reduces trainable parameters by ~78.56% vs AlexNet and 6.34% vs LeNet, resulting in 41,610 parameters
Achieves 98.42% precision, 97.84% recall, and 88.66% test accuracy on Fashion MNIST
Training accuracy of 90.04% on Fashion MNIST

papers.title: A Novel Deep Neural Network Model for Image Classification
papers.venue: International Journal of Engineering and Advanced Technology

notes.problem: Which CNN and RNN architectures achieve best image classification accuracy on standard benchmark datasets?
limitations: Limited architecture variants explored
No comparison to state-of-the-art models
notes.contribution: Comparison of CNN and LSTM architectures for image classification on Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10
key_findings: CNN1 achieves greater accuracy on Fashion-MNIST
CNN3, LSTM1, and LSTM2 perform better than other models on CIFAR-10

papers.title: Evaluating the Impact of Data Augmentation on Image Classification Accuracy
papers.venue: TRAP@NCI (National College of Ireland)

notes.problem: Which data augmentation strategy best improves deep learning image classification accuracy and generalization?
limitations: Single CNN architecture used limits generalizability of findings
Study scope limited to three datasets

key_findings: No single augmentation technique is universally superior; optimal choice depends on dataset type, model sensitivity, and augmentation objective
GAN methods are most effective for handling class imbalance and generating diverse samples
Mix-based methods perform well in low-data conditions with computational efficiency advantages

papers.title: Penerapan Arsitektur EfficientNet dalam Model CNN untuk Optimalisasi Klasifikasi Gambar Fashion pada Dataset Fashion MNIST
papers.venue: INCODING Journal of Informatics and Computer Science Engineering

notes.problem: How well does EfficientNet perform on Fashion-MNIST compared to standard CNN, VGG16, XG-ViT, and DRQCNN baselines?

Experiments limited to a single grayscale low-resolution dataset (Fashion-MNIST).

key_findings: EfficientNet achieved accuracy=0.9429, precision=0.9426, recall=0.9429, F1-score=0.9425 on Fashion-MNIST.

Trouser and Bag classes achieved highest performance, while T-shirt/top and Shirt were most challenging due to visual similarity.

papers.title: CNN-based Predictive Analytics Models for ERP-Supported E-commerce

notes.problem: How can deep learning predictive analytics enhance ERP-supported e-commerce systems while addressing overfitting and class misclassification?

papers.title: Context Augmentation for Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.venue: arXiv (Cornell University)

notes.problem: How does background context in training images affect CNN classification accuracy, and can augmenting backgrounds improve performance?
limitations: Evaluated primarily on small datasets; generalization to large-scale benchmarks unclear
notes.contribution: Proposes context augmentation by placing foreground-segmented objects on varied backgrounds to improve CNN image classification, especially with small datasets.
key_findings: Changing backgrounds of training datasets can have drastic effects on testing accuracies
Augmenting training data with foreground-segmented objects on varied backgrounds improves accuracy when only small datasets are available

papers.title: A lightweight hybrid deep learning approach for fashion mnist classification with explainable attention visualization
papers.venue: PLoS ONE

notes.problem: How to classify fashion images accurately in resource-constrained environments without large CNNs or Transformers requiring powerful GPUs
limitations: Evaluated only on Fashion-MNIST dataset
May not generalize to more complex or higher-resolution fashion datasets
notes.contribution: A lightweight hybrid TinyCNN+Linear Self-Attention model with under 500K parameters for fashion image classification with XAI interpretability
key_findings: Proposed TinyCNN+LSA achieves 91.47% accuracy on Fashion-MNIST with fewer than 500K parameters trainable on CPU
Multiple XAI techniques provide visual interpretability of model predictions

papers.title: Peer Review #1 of "Full depth CNN classifier for handwritten and license plate characters recognition (v0.1)"

notes.problem: How to design a simple, low-complexity CNN that achieves high accuracy on handwritten and license plate character recognition tasks.
limitations: This is a peer review document, not the paper itself, limiting assessment of methodology details.
notes.contribution: A full-depth stacked CNN architecture for Latin and Arabic handwritten alphanumeric and license plate character recognition achieving low error rates with low complexity.
key_findings: Error rates: 0.28% on MNIST, 0.34% on MAHDB, 1.45% on AHCD, 3.81% on AIA9K, 5.00% on Fashion-MNIST, 0.26% on Saudi LP characters, 0.97% on Latin LP characters.
The proposed four-conv-layer architecture achieves competitive accuracy with low complexity.

papers.title: Peer Review #3 of "Full depth CNN classifier for handwritten and license plate characters recognition (v0.2)"

notes.problem: How to achieve high accuracy character recognition with a low-complexity CNN architecture
limitations: Evaluation limited to isolated characters; no end-to-end scene text or full plate recognition tested
notes.contribution: A full depth stacked CNN architecture for Latin and Arabic handwritten alphanumeric and license plate character recognition
key_findings: Error of 0.28% on MNIST, 0.34% on MAHDB, 1.45% on AHCD, 3.81% on AIA9K, 5.00% on Fashion-MNIST, 0.26% on Saudi LP characters, and 0.97% on Latin LP characters
The proposed four conv layer architecture is low-complexity yet achieves competitive accuracy across multiple benchmarks

papers.title: Chaotic CNN for Limited Data Image Classification
papers.venue: arXiv.org

notes.problem: CNNs overfit and show poor generalization when training data is scarce.
limitations: Evaluated only on standard benchmark datasets; real-world data-scarce domains not tested.
Only greyscale and one RGB dataset used; broader generalization unclear.
notes.contribution: A chaos-based feature transformation using logistic, skew tent, and sine maps is proposed to improve CNN generalization under limited data without adding trainable parameters.
key_findings: Maximum gain of 5.43% on MNIST using skew tent map with 3-layer CNN at 40 samples per class.
Gain of 9.11% on Fashion-MNIST using sine map with 3-layer CNN at 50 samples per class.
Gain of 7.47% on CIFAR-10 using skew tent map at 200 samples per class.

papers.title: Multi class image classification of natural scenes via convolutional neural network with dynamic data augmentation
papers.venue: International Journal of Computing and Artificial Intelligence

notes.problem: How to accurately classify complex natural scene images with highly unstructured spatial features.
limitations: Evaluated on a single dataset
Six fixed classes may not generalize to broader scene categories
notes.contribution: A custom deep CNN with dynamic data augmentation achieving 96.6% accuracy on six-class natural scene classification.
key_findings: Model achieved 96.6% peak classification accuracy over 100 training epochs
Progressive filter depth from 64 to 512 with batch normalization improved generalization
Dynamic augmentation including shifts, shearing, zooming, and flipping enhanced robustness
